description: Fix Python formatter invocation mismatch and initialize sections

files_modified.reason: hyprsnap_process.py calls formatter.format_output(...) but class defines format(...). Added format_output method with proper section initialization and kept format as backward-compatible alias.

issues_addressed: Method invocation mismatch between processor and formatter
Dynamic sections (toc, changelog, semantic_map, etc.) not initialized before formatting
Issues and completions formatting lacked structure and line numbers
improvements: Added format_output method that properly initializes all dynamic sections
Maintained backward compatibility with format method as alias
Enhanced issue formatting with categorized buckets and line numbers
Improved completion formatting with line number references
rollback_notes: Can revert by removing format_output method and restoring original format method
